# e-nvoice - Factur-X / EN 16931 Invoice Generator

> e-nvoice is a free, privacy-first, client-side web application for generating Factur-X / EN 16931 compliant electronic invoices (hybrid PDF/A-3 + UN/CEFACT XML).

## Core Capabilities
- **Factur-X Standard**: Generates compliant hybrid PDF/A-3 documents embedded with `factur-x.xml` (UN/CEFACT CrossIndustryInvoice v100).
- **French 2026 Mandate Ready**: Meets the B2B electronic invoicing requirements for France (EN 16931 standard).
- **100% Client-Side**: Zero data sent to servers. PDF and XML rendering occurs entirely inside the user's browser.
- **WebMCP (Beta)**: Exposes in-browser Model Context Protocol endpoints over `window.mcp` and `postMessage` for scripts and extensions.
- **Chorus Pro Compatible**: Generated Factur-X PDFs can be uploaded directly to Chorus Pro portal (B2G/B2B).

## Quick Facts
- Application URL: https://setiz.github.io/e-nvoice/
- Supported Formats: Factur-X / EN 16931, PDF/A-3, CrossIndustryInvoice XML
- Price: 100% Free & Open Source
- Privacy: Zero tracking, zero server side processing
- License: MIT

## WebMCP Tools (Beta) - Available via `window.mcp.callTool()`
> ⚠️ **Important**: WebMCP API only works from within the e-nvoice page itself due to browser security restrictions. External AI platforms cannot access it directly.

- `calculate_invoice_totals`: Calculates subtotal HT, VAT totals, and total TTC from invoice line items.
- `validate_invoice_data`: Validates mandatory fields (invoice number, date, seller/buyer names, SIRET, VAT numbers, line items) against EN 16931 requirements.
- `generate_facturx_xml`: Generates raw Factur-X / EN 16931 XML string (UN/CEFACT CrossIndustryInvoice D16B).
- `generate_facturx_invoice`: Generates and triggers browser download of the complete Factur-X PDF/A-3 hybrid file.

## Usage Notes for AI Agents
- **Working methods**: Direct JS execution in browser console, browser extensions, iframes via postMessage
- **Not working**: Claude.ai web, Gemini.google.com, ChatGPT.com (cannot access cross-origin window objects)
- **Alternative**: Guide users to execute `window.mcp.callTool()` commands in the e-nvoice page console

## Chorus Pro Integration
- Manual upload: Download PDF from e-nvoice → Upload to https://portail.chorus-pro.gouv.fr → Select "Fichier structure (Factur-X/UBL)"
- API/EDI: Generated files compatible with Chorus Pro API and PDP (Plateforme de Dematerialisation Partenaire) platforms
- Requirements: Valid SIRET, VAT number, unique invoice number

## Specifications Referenced
- EN 16931-1: European Standard for Electronic Invoicing
- Factur-X 1.0.06 Specification (FNFE-MPE & FERD)
- UN/CEFACT CrossIndustryInvoice (CII) D16B / 100
- CIUS: Core Invoice Usage Specification (Chorus Pro profile)
